stem.text: Which row about the structure of proteins is correct?

A.text: is the number of amino acids present in a protein; is the left-handed spiral formed by the primary structure; is the sub-unit polypeptides that link together to form a protein

B.text: is the order of amino acids present in a protein encoded by DNA; is the coiling of a chain of amino acids to form a β-pleated sheet or α-helix; contains two types of polypeptide that interact forming the shape of a protein

C.text: is the result of translation of an mRNA molecule by a ribosome into a chain of amino acids; occurs because of attraction between hydrogen and oxygen atoms in the peptide bonds; is formed by four polypeptides and an additional reactive group attached to the protein

D.text: is the sequence of amino acids in a protein coded by an mRNA molecule; is formed by hydrogen bonding between amino acids forming the primary structure; is formed by the linking together of more than one polypeptide to form a protein
